blocks.purpose: 固定共同时间比较两车距离

design.organizing_model: A trip is one total distance and all elapsed time; moving speed alone cannot tell us its average.

representation.observation: 同一时间速度翻倍，距离翻倍

design.revision_reason: Make the time denominator visible before comparing speeds.

target.expected_performance: Distinguish moving time from total elapsed time

details: Recent interpretations only; tutor.step understanding with after pages current records. evidence_ref reads exact details; trace pages earlier facts and event_id reads exact content.

move.prompt: 共同时间保持 10 秒，先看 A、B 各走 10 米，再改变 B。

target.expected_performance: Distinguish moving time from total elapsed time

assumptions: 构造的匀速运动；无加速、摩擦或碰撞。对照模型不自动证明现实观察数据中的因果关系。
content.readable_content: A 保持 1 米/秒，B 可设为 0–3 米/秒。两车从同一起点出发，共用 0–10 秒的时间和 0–30 米的尺度。输入速度应用后才更新距离图。距离等于速度乘时间；同一正时间下，B 的速度翻倍，其距离也翻倍。可自行改参数、拖动时间、显示关系或提问。
